Clean lines. Considered details. Luxury-grade vegan materials.

The Structured Tote holds the small chaos of a day with a baby, and gives nothing away.

settings.title: Tailored composure
settings.body: A structured silhouette with a quilted front pocket, embroidered wordmark, and logo-stamped zipper pulls — it reads handbag, not diaper bag.

settings.title: Opens flat, packs smart
settings.body: A lay-flat design that unzips like a suitcase: mesh compartments you can see into, gold clasp snaps, and an extended zipper tail for one-hand closing.

settings.title: Clips to the stroller
settings.body: Two detachable straps clasp straight onto the stroller — and the front zip pocket keeps bottles upright and within reach.

settings.title: Carries your office too
settings.body: A padded laptop sleeve tucked behind the compartments, a key ring where you'll find it, and firm zipper sides that hold their shape.

settings.heading: Built by a working mom, for working moms.
settings.body:
Bossababy was born in the gap between two worlds. Every bag on the market made us choose: look polished, or be prepared. We refused to pick.

So we designed one bag that does both. A silhouette refined enough for the boardroom, engineered with intelligent compartments for everything from a laptop to a change of onesies — because motherhood and elegance were never opposites.
settings.signoff: You've got this. We've got your bag.
